assumptions.label: Machine class
assumptions.help: The mechanical architecture and payload envelope of the autonomous robot executing the hour of work.

assumptions.label: Deployment duty
assumptions.help: Annual operating hours based on 1-shift (8h), 2-shift (16h), or continuous 3-shift (24/7) facility operations.

assumptions.label: Inference compute
assumptions.help: Onboard neural processing power consumption across embedded Edge NPU, Hybrid Edge+VLA, or Cloud foundation reasoning.

assumptions.label: Human wage comparison
assumptions.help: Prevailing fully-loaded hourly wage of manual human workers replaced or augmented in that jurisdiction.

cyclesPerHour.label: Joint cycles per hour
cyclesPerHour.derivation: Average 2 cycles per second across 6–30 articulated joint degrees of freedom.

gridCarbonGPerKWh.label: Grid carbon intensity
gridCarbonGPerKWh.derivation: Weighted global manufacturing grid electricity emissions intensity.

embodiedSiliconGPerKg.label: Silicon per robot kg
embodiedSiliconGPerKg.derivation: Total packaged semiconductor die mass per kg of finished mechatronic robot.

refinedMetalFactor.label: Refined metal multiplier
refinedMetalFactor.derivation: Ratio of virgin refined metals (NdFeB, Cu, 100Cr6, Li) to finished robot mass.

oreToRefinedRatio.label: Ore extraction ratio
oreToRefinedRatio.derivation: Mass of raw mined ore (bastnäsite, bauxite, iron ore, spodumene) per unit of refined engineering material.

maintOverheadFactor.label: Maintenance & spare ratio
maintOverheadFactor.derivation: Annual maintenance, spare joints, and grease replenishment as percentage of initial capex.

chain.name: Autonomous Work Hour
chain.note: One continuous hour of physical task execution (picking, welding, transport, or assembly).

chain.name: Actuator Joint Cycles
chain.note: Cumulative mechanical oscillation and rotation cycles across all arm and leg joints.

chain.name: Electrical Energy
chain.note: Total grid electricity drawn for joint actuation, holding stall torque, compute NPU, and sensors.

chain.name: Design Life Consumed
chain.note: Fraction of the robot's certified MTBF / B10 mechanical life expended during this hour.

chain.name: Amortized Hardware Mass
chain.note: Mass of physical robot chassis, motors, and reducers allocated to this single hour of service.

chain.name: Amortized Silicon Mass
chain.note: Pure monocrystalline silicon die mass embodied in motor MCUs, GaN power stages, and edge NPUs.

chain.name: Refined Engineering Alloys
chain.note: Virgin sintered NdFeB magnets, cathode chemicals, copper wire, and vacuum-melted gear steels.

chain.name: Lithosphere Mined Ore
chain.note: Total raw mined rock (bastnäsite rare earth ore, iron ore, bauxite, spodumene) extracted from the earth.

branches.name: Hourly Hardware Amortisation
branches.note: Depreciation of initial machine purchase price over operational service life.

branches.name: Net Labor Arbitrage
branches.note: Net cost difference between manual human labor and the fully-loaded autonomous robot hour.

branches.name: Emissions Footprint
branches.note: Grid greenhouse gas emissions generated per operational robot hour.

stepSources.work_hour: Canonical terminal unit across all 3 machine classes.
stepSources.joint_cycles: Average 2 Hz cyclic motion across 6-to-30 DOF robotic joints.
stepSources.electrical_energy: Sum of motor mechanical output, I²R resistive winding heat, and onboard NPU compute.
stepSources.wear_fraction: Inverse of certified B10 design life (15,000–30,000 operating hours).
stepSources.embodied_hardware: Robot total mass divided by rated operating lifetime hours.
stepSources.semiconductor_silicon: Total silicon die area in edge SoCs, MCUs, and drivers amortized per hour.
stepSources.refined_materials: Upstream feedstock required including machining kerf and casting yields.
stepSources.lithosphere_ore: Geological grade concentration factors across bastnäsite, iron ore, and spodumene.
